experiences.title: Vocal Quest - University Capstone Project
experiences.subtitle: Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka
workDescription: Worked on the frontend, backend and **UI/UX design** of an AI-driven accessible gaming platform.
Developed features using **React, Node.js, Express.js and MongoDB**.
Worked on authentication, routes and accessibility features for users with visual and motor disabilities.
Designed user flows and interfaces using **Figma**.
